caption: The drawing features a composition of abstract shapes and forms outlined primarily in red-orange, set against a gray speckled background with a beige border. On the left side, there is a small, frog-like figure with a solid black oval in its midsection and splayed limbs. The central portion is dominated by a large, elongated form resembling a fish or aquatic creature, with a black, segmented interior and red-orange contours. Several additional abstract shapes and lines branch from the main form, including zigzag lines, arched shapes, and ringed appendages. On the right, there are circular and gear-like structures, filled with radial and striped patterns, and a segmented oval shape filled with parallel vertical lines and bordered by jagged and wavy components. The entire composition uses a limited color palette of red-orange, black, white, and shades of gray.
title: Petroglyph - Human Figures
